title: Shortest Path with One Discount
description: You are given a directed weighted graph from city 1 to city N. You may apply one coupon to one edge, reducing its cost to floor(weight / 2). Find the minimum possible route cost. If city N is unreachable, print -1.
constraints: Each edge is directed and has an integer weight W where 1 <= W <= 1000000000.
Use the coupon at most once; applying it to an edge of weight 1 costs 0.
hints: Treat each city as two states: coupon unused and coupon already used.
Run Dijkstra over the 2 * N states.

examples.explanation: Use the coupon on edge 1 -> 2: floor(5 / 2) = 2. Route 1 -> 2 -> 5 then costs 2 + 5 = 7.
